submitted_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2021-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2022-01-01' AND billing_country = 'Germany') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2021-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2022-01-01'), 0), 2) AS germany_billing_share_percent;
validated_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2021-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE) AND billing_country = 'Germany') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2021-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE)), 0), 2) AS germany_billing_share_percent LIMIT 200
